compiled_state.title: In progress tickets do not show in progress in Jira
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body: Investigation (2026-05-12): acli-integration.py _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA mapping correctly maps 'in_progress' → 'In Progress' (line 54). Transition code at line 383 uses this mapping. Code is correct. Possible causes: (1) Jira workflow does not have 'In Progress' transition configured, (2) tickets missing SYNC event (not created in Jira first), (3) ACLI transition command failing silently. Recommend checking BRIDGE_ALERT events on affected in_progress tickets and verifying Jira workflow transitions.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigation complete: Code in acli-integration.py is correct — _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map (lines 52-57) correctly maps 'in_progress' → 'In Progress'. No Jira admin access to verify project workflow configuration (whether the In Progress transition is available, or whether API credentials have transition permissions). Cannot resolve without Jira admin access. Leaving open pending environment access.

comments.body: Investigation complete: ROOT_CAUSE is the same as 5566-685e — outbound bridge cap-exceeded silently drops all events. In-progress tickets are not synced because NO tickets are synced (0/462 have jira_key). The cap fires on every run before any STATUS events are processed. Shared root cause with 5566-685e; fix in _outbound_cursor.py will resolve both.
